display: English teacher at an international school in Xiamen, owner of a dachshund recovering from back surgery.

signals.text: My dachshund Pickle had spinal disc (IVDD) surgery in August, and his vet recommends hydrotherapy (underwater treadmill) twice a week. I haven't found any in Xiamen.
I have three price lists from a pet physio in Fuzhou. I can't tell what the session cards, first-evaluation fee and boarding actually cover.
My Chinese colleague helped with the Fuzhou price list, but neither of us knows the veterinary terms. I need someone who really understands pet rehab packages.
I'm looking for any Xiamen vet or physio who does canine rehab, even something simpler than a pool, or someone who knows someone.
I can only travel on weekends because of school, so I'm weighing a Saturday routine or a day trip to Fuzhou against rehab closer to home.
I'm planning a day trip to Fuzhou on 18 October to see the rehab centre, and it would help to bring a checklist of questions to ask.
I'm going to Leeds for Christmas and Pickle can't fly while he's recovering. I need someone trustworthy in Xiamen who can look after a dog with spinal-surgery needs for about two weeks.
Rehab costs on top of the surgery bill are a worry. I can spend roughly 6,000 RMB a month at most.
I can't leave Pickle alone for more than four hours, so my weekends and Golden Week are built around him.
My Mandarin covers menus and ordering beer, not contracts or medical documents, so I need things explained in English or very simple Chinese.

offers.text: Qualified English teacher (CELTA, PGCE) with experience teaching literature to Years 7 to 11. I can offer English conversation practice or help with essays and texts.
Practical home setup for a dog recovering from spinal surgery: a padded recovery pen, foam ramps and a homemade support harness. I'm happy to share what worked.
A WeChat account where about 40 school parents follow Pickle's recovery. I can ask in that circle for local pet-care contacts.
A native English speaker's help with English-language materials, such as proofreading, a rehab centre's English intro, or an expat-facing pet-care guide.
I can write up Pickle's recovery as a clear English-language case log, covering what the surgeon advised and what progress to expect. It could help other IVDD dog owners in China.
A Saturday five-a-side football game, and a pub afterwards, for anyone new to Xiamen.
A second-hand van that carries a dog crate comfortably, for weekend trips.

catchers.hypo: Hi, I run a small pet rehab clinic in Fuzhou. I could explain our package prices to an English speaker and hold a Saturday slot for a dog after spinal surgery.
catchers.can: Tom can compare the three price lists with them, and book a first evaluation on a Saturday if the terms fit his budget.
catchers.confirm: Do you offer hydrotherapy or underwater treadmill sessions for dogs after IVDD surgery, with a Saturday slot, and can you explain the package contents in English?

catchers.hypo: I'm a vet nurse in Xiamen and I've helped dogs recover from back surgery. I can look at what rehab options exist locally.
catchers.can: Tom can ask for a home-exercise plan or a local referral, and bring Pickle in on a weekend.
catchers.confirm: Have you personally worked on post-operative rehabilitation for dogs with IVDD, in or near Xiamen?

catchers.hypo: I'm a Mandarin speaker with a veterinary background. I can read pet clinic packages and tell you what 'session card' and 'first evaluation' usually mean.
catchers.can: Tom's colleague Li Na already helps him with documents but lacks the vet vocabulary. A vet-literate translator would close that gap.
catchers.confirm: Can you read a Chinese pet physio price list and explain in English which items are one-off fees and which are per session?

catchers.hypo: I'm a dog lover in Xiamen who can house-sit over Christmas. I've looked after a dog on crate rest before.
catchers.can: Tom could introduce them to Pickle and arrange a trial visit before he flies to Leeds on 23 December.
catchers.confirm: Are you able to keep a post-surgery dog on strict crate rest, and be present for most of the day, for around two weeks in late December?

catchers.hypo: My dog has just had back surgery and I'm panicking. What did you do in the first weeks?
catchers.can: Tom can talk through the early weeks with them, including the recovery pen, ramps, harness and crate rest.
catchers.confirm: Is your dog currently recovering from spinal or disc surgery, rather than a minor injury?

catchers.hypo: I just moved to Xiamen for a school job and don't know anyone. Is there a casual weekend football group?
catchers.can: Tom can invite them to Saturday five-a-side on the school astro pitch, and the pub afterwards.
catchers.confirm: Do you want a friendly, low-skill weekend game and are you fine with a team that mostly loses?

catchers.hypo: I'm an international school teacher in China planning a trip to Leeds and I'd like a local to show me round.
catchers.can: Tom's sister Becca lives in Leeds and organises things, so he could ask her for local advice on restaurants and logistics.
catchers.confirm: Are you travelling to Leeds, and is what you need local advice rather than a place to stay?

catchers.hypo: I teach English literature and am designing a role-play trial for 'An Inspector Calls'. Do you have ideas for classroom activities?
catchers.can: Tom is running a role-play trial of the Birling family with his Year 10 class and can swap materials and ideas.
catchers.confirm: Are you teaching 'An Inspector Calls' or a similar class-and-guilt text to teenagers?

forbids.text: I can't leave Xiamen on weekdays, so any trip has to fit a weekend.
Pickle can't be left alone for more than four hours.
I won't put Pickle in airline cargo, and he can't fly at all while he is recovering.
I need everything explained in English or very simple Chinese. I can't handle Chinese contracts or technical documents alone.
My rehab budget is roughly 6,000 RMB a month at most.

projects.name: Pickle recovery plan
projects.text: My dachshund had IVDD back surgery in August. The surgeon recommends hydrotherapy twice a week for at least eight weeks. I'm looking for a workable rehab setup, in Xiamen or a weekend-friendly option in Fuzhou.
roles_needed: dog owner who has been through IVDD recovery

policy.t1: What rehab was recommended, where I have looked, the price-list confusion, my weekend availability, and my Christmas pet-care need.
policy.t2: The cost of the surgery, my monthly rehab budget and the money strain.
policy.never: Family arguments, and how lonely I sometimes feel.
